Direct listed bonuses only; all-attribute bonuses are included in STR, AGI and INT. Strength-derived HP, auras and temporary effects are not added. Hp Regen shows HP/sec or % of maximum HP/sec; these units sort in separate groups. “—” means no matching direct bonus is listed. Multiple values are preserved and sorted by their first value.

Data audited 31 October 2026: Valve item feed for 500 of 501 records; tracked game definitions for recipes and shop availability. One historical record is unverified. Some historical effects have unavailable values. Item artwork © Valve, loaded from Steam CDN.
Reference: Liquipedia Item statistics. Category labels use the supplied Liquipedia table; original dataset from OpenDota. Tags are curated interpretations, not Valve classifications. All dataset items may include historical or special-mode entries.
